description: Expose each recibo's document type in the colaborador (employee portal) API so the panel can distinguish FOLHA_MENSAL vs FERIAS vs ADIANTAMENTO_13, plus surface the férias-specific fields (diasFerias, periodoAquisitivoInicio, periodoAquisitivoFim) that already exist on folhas_pagamento but are not currently returned. The user explicitly asked the collaborator panel to recognize both férias and 13º documents. Response shapes stay backward-compatible (add fields, never remove). Independent of FEAT-001: it only reads existing columns and touches colaborador.service.ts; ordered second because FEAT-001 is the primary ask.
steps: src/colaborador/colaborador.service.ts listRecibos: add folhasPagamento.tipo (and folhasPagamento.diasFerias) to the inner select, and include `tipo: r.tipo ?? 'FOLHA_MENSAL'` (and diasFerias ?? null) in each mapped recibo object.

src/colaborador/colaborador.service.ts getReciboDetalhe: add folhasPagamento.tipo, diasFerias, periodoAquisitivoInicio, periodoAquisitivoFim to the folha select block, and return them on the DTO (tipo defaulting to 'FOLHA_MENSAL'; the three férias fields defaulting to null).

src/colaborador/colaborador.service.ts getReciboPdf: add folhasPagamento.tipo (and the férias fields where meaningful) to the select and return tipo in the result object so the PDF/data payload carries the document type.

Confirm src/colaborador/colaborador.controller.ts needs no change (endpoints pass service DTOs straight through). If the controller reshapes any of these responses, thread the new tipo field through unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: listRecibos, getReciboDetalhe, and getReciboPdf each include a `tipo` field whose value is one of FOLHA_MENSAL / FERIAS / ADIANTAMENTO_13 for the corresponding folha.
getReciboDetalhe (and getReciboPdf where meaningful) also include diasFerias, periodoAquisitivoInicio, periodoAquisitivoFim for férias recibos.
No previously-returned field is removed from any colaborador recibo DTO (backward compatible).
`npm run build` compiles clean and `npm test` is green.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Only src/colaborador/colaborador.service.ts was modified; colaborador.controller.ts needed NO change (it returns the service DTOs straight through: listRecibos returns result.data unchanged, getRecibo/getReciboPdf return the service object as-is, so the new fields pass through automatically).

Column names on folhasPagamento (confirmed against src/database/schema.ts): tipo (text, NOT NULL, default 'FOLHA_MENSAL'), diasFerias (integer, nullable), periodoAquisitivoInicio (date, nullable), periodoAquisitivoFim (date, nullable).

listRecibos: added folhasPagamento.tipo and folhasPagamento.diasFerias to the inner select; each mapped recibo now also returns `tipo: r.tipo ?? 'FOLHA_MENSAL'` and `diasFerias: r.diasFerias ?? null`. (periodoAquisitivo* intentionally NOT added to the list payload — the FEAT-002 step only specified tipo + diasFerias for listRecibos.)

getReciboDetalhe: added tipo, diasFerias, periodoAquisitivoInicio, periodoAquisitivoFim to the folha select block; DTO now returns tipo (?? 'FOLHA_MENSAL') plus the three férias fields (each ?? null) at the top level of the recibo object, alongside the existing competencia/periodoInicio/periodoFim.

getReciboPdf: added the same four fields to the folha select block; the returned ReciboData-shaped object now carries tipo (?? 'FOLHA_MENSAL') and diasFerias / periodoAquisitivoInicio / periodoAquisitivoFim (each ?? null) at the top level, next to competencia/periodoInicio/periodoFim. No existing field removed anywhere — fully backward-compatible (additive only).

For the web/portal consumer: tipo is one of 'FOLHA_MENSAL' | 'FERIAS' | 'ADIANTAMENTO_13' (string, defaults to 'FOLHA_MENSAL' if the column is null for legacy rows). The férias-specific fields are null for non-férias recibos.

Verification: `npm run build` passes clean (exit 0). `npm test` — all colaborador and rh suites pass (incl. colaborador-revocation, rh-extraction, rh-ferias-extraction, rh-adiantamento13-extraction). The ONLY failing suites are src/fiscal/services/nfse-webiss.parser.spec.ts and src/fiscal/services/importacao-xml-fiscal.service.spec.ts, which fail with ENOENT on missing NFSe_*.xml fixture files at the monorepo root (D:\dev\kontabb\NFSe_*.xml). Verified pre-existing and unrelated to this change by git-stashing colaborador.service.ts and re-running the fiscal spec — it fails identically (5 failed) with the change reverted. These are environment/fixture issues outside FEAT-002's scope.
